feed.headline: Shock of rail tragedy gives way to sorrow and outrage in politically divided Spain
feed.ai: The latest train crash will pile pressure on the government of Pedro Sánchez, one month before the general election.

feed.headline: Student-backed election winners demand sweeping resignations in Serbia
feed.ai: Days after ousting Aleksandar Vučić's party from power, Student List MPs call for top figures to stand down.

feed.headline: Post Office suspends sending goods to the EU
feed.ai: It follows a delay in updates to processing systems to allow for changes to EU customs rules.

feed.headline: EU chief lays out vision for new Canada partnership at Montreal summit
feed.ai: Ursula von der Leyen continued to use the term "associate member" for Canada despite some opposition of the bloc's members, including Germany.

feed.headline: Joy and disbelief on Serbian streets as Vučić concedes election defeat
feed.ai: BBC correspondent Nick Thorpe reports from Belgrade, where there were rapturous celebrations following the victory of the student-led movement.

feed.headline: Who actually controls Ukraine's access to Starlink?
feed.ai: President Zelensky says limits to the technology continue to affect Ukrainian forces, while US officials and Elon Musk offer conflicting accounts of who controls it.

feed.headline: Are the French riots a warning of an intense election to come?
feed.ai: Rioting, looting and vandalism has gripped France over the weekend after protests spiralled out of control across the country.

feed.headline: In Marseille, Macron Confronts a Potent Mix of France’s Problems
feed.ai: France’s second city, five years into a presidential development plan, is grappling with the social strains that have fueled protests across the country.

feed.headline: Nvidia CEO sees Kazakhstan as potential AI hub for Europe
feed.ai: During his first visit to Kazakhstan, Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang said the country's growing computing capacity could make it a major AI hub for Europe, as Kazakhstan expands its energy and digital infrastructure.

feed.headline: Islamic states prosecutors call for global enforcement coalition
feed.ai: Law enforcement heads from 46 Islamic states gather in Baku to tackle cross-border financial crime, artificial intelligence and international asset recovery.

feed.headline: Italy: Thousands protest rising living costs and defence spending in general strike
feed.ai: Thousands of protesters marched through Rome, Italy, on Friday, 30 October, during a general strike called by the left-wing Unione Sindacale di Base (USB) trade union.

feed.headline: Carney to push for closer ties at Canada-EU summit in Montreal
feed.ai: The term "associate member" is reportedly off the table as officials discuss deeper economic and defence ties.
